cost: O(C+token text) ordinary scan and O(C+T+depth) memory; line_rest allocates trimmed lines for block comments. No source-size cap.
description: lex scans Unicode chars, maintains one-based line/char-column, whitespace-before flag and delimiter stack. Numbers normalize D exponent for parsing and imaginary suffix j/J/I to i spelling. Apostrophe after a value is Quote except whitespace in matrix/cell context, where it starts Str. Newline is emitted; ... consumes remainder and newline. EOF token always appended.

inverse: Accepted token sequences exclude treating [a 'x']'s spaced quote as transpose, or a' as a string opener. Unterminated strings exclude Ok; invalid characters exclude tokens past the error. Scanner does not reject unmatched delimiters or unterminated block-comment EOF; these are not lexer validation guarantees.

For tokens T, preimage is all Unicode strings whose contextual scan yields T including retained locations/space flags. Comments, quote escapes and normalized imaginary suffixes can collapse. Removing coordinate observations enlarges fibers further; token text is not an exact inverse source serializer.
limitations: Partial lexical syntax, no semantic proof or executable surrogate
